scope: blind exact-row input, output and pair verification

reviews.critique: The input is a plausible, coherent set of resident notes with recoverable intent and no artificial padding or leaked instructions. The output provides restrained, conversational polish through capitalization, punctuation, contractions, and occasional active phrasing. Across the narrative, numbered summary, and closing conditions, it preserves the names, locations, quantities, measurements, quotations, requests, denials, and uncertainty about moisture, maintenance, and cardboard pickup. It adds no facts or framing and makes no material omissions.

The input is a coherent, plausible dictated account with clear paragraph and numbered-list cues, recoverable intent, and no apparent padding or leaked authoring instructions. The output applies capitalization, punctuation, hyphenation, and list formatting without lexical paraphrasing or material omissions. Across all paragraphs, it preserves the names, quantities, train times, booking-code distinction, single five-pound charge per booking, unused-ticket statements, conditional before-four deadline, absence of a payment-update date, and retention of both original tickets. The changes are appropriate for /transcribe.
